title: Frame
subtitle: 本課集中處理 frame = compose / position a subject within a visual view 的攝影、電影與視覺構圖義項。 不處理 frame
description: 本課集中處理 frame = compose / position a subject within a visual view 的攝影、電影與視覺構圖義項。 不處理 frame a question / frame an argument / frame someone for a crime 等其他動詞義項。

words.example: The photographer composed the shot so that the bridge led the eye towards the skyline.
words.exampleZh: 攝影師安排構圖，讓橋樑把視線引向天際線。

exercises.original: The photographer framed the image so that the road led towards the mountains.
exercises.zh: 攝影師安排構圖，讓道路把視線帶向山脈。
exercises.upgrade: A. Compose · 構圖；安排畫面

options.explanation: Compose ✓ — arrange the visual elements of an image into an effective composition。這句的決定性線索是 the whole visual composition is being designed。因此 Compose 最準確表達這種 frame。
Position — place a subject or object in a particular location within the visual field。position 只聚焦主體位置；若句子是在設計整體構圖、排列多個元素或單純確保某物入鏡，可能不夠完整。
Centre — place the main subject at or near the centre of the image。centre 只表示置中；如果主體是 off-centre、沿三分線或只需出現在鏡頭內，就不適合。
Crop — remove unwanted outer parts of an image。crop 是刪走影像邊緣內容，通常屬拍攝後或取景裁切；它不是安排主體位置。
Zoom — change magnification or field of view。zoom 改變焦距／視角大小，不決定主體在畫面中的具體構圖。
Focus — adjust sharpness or choose what appears sharp。focus 關乎清晰度，不是畫面位置與構圖。

exercises.zh: 她構圖時把窗戶安排在主體稍後方。
exercises.upgrade: B. Compose · 構圖；安排畫面

Crop — remove unwanted outer parts of an image。crop 是刪走影像邊緣內容，通常屬拍攝後或取景裁切；它不是安排主體位置。
Zoom — change magnification or field of view。zoom 改變焦距／視角大小，不決定主體在畫面中的具體構圖。
Line up ✓ — align a subject or visual feature with another element。這句的決定性線索是 visual alignment is the key operation。因此 Line up 最準確表達這種 frame。
Focus — adjust sharpness or choose what appears sharp。focus 關乎清晰度，不是畫面位置與構圖。

exercises.original: She framed the tower so that it aligned with the gap between the trees.
exercises.zh: 她安排塔樓位置，使它與樹木之間的空隙對齊。
exercises.upgrade: F. Line up · 對齊；把……排入畫面

words.meaning: 納入鏡頭；讓……出現在畫面中
words.example: The photographer included the old station sign in the shot to give the location context.
words.exampleZh: 攝影師把舊車站招牌納入鏡頭，讓畫面更有地點背景。

exercises.original: The photographer framed the street sign to show where the photograph was taken.
exercises.zh: 攝影師把街道標誌納入畫面，交代拍攝地點。
exercises.upgrade: A. Include in the shot · 納入鏡頭；讓……出現在畫面中

options.explanation: Include in the shot ✓ — make sure a person, object, or feature appears within the visible shot。這句的決定性線索是 the main requirement is simply that the sign appears in the image。因此 Include in the shot 最準確表達這種 frame。

exercises.zh: 拍訪問時要確保兩名講者都在鏡頭內。

falseSynonyms.zh: 裁剪 ≠ frame crop 是拍攝後或取景時刪走畫面邊緣內容；frame 是決定畫面內如何呈現。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cropping removes; framing arranges.

falseSynonyms.zh: 變焦 ≠ frame zoom 改變焦距／視角大小，不等於構圖安排。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Zoom changes magnification/field of view.

falseSynonyms.zh: 對焦 ≠ frame focus 決定哪裏清晰；frame 決定畫面包含甚麼、如何安排。
拍下 ≠ frame capture 是取得影像；frame 是拍攝前／拍攝時的畫面安排。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Capture is the act of recording.

falseSynonyms.zh: 拍攝 ≠ frame shoot 是拍照／拍片的整體行為，不等於構圖。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Shooting is broader than framing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 剪輯／編輯 ≠ frame edit 通常是拍攝後處理影像或影片。
旋轉 ≠ frame rotate 只改變方向，不等於構圖安排。
詞形陷阱 frame 可作動詞／名詞；framing 可作名詞／分詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Check word class and role.
